collection.title: Jaguar XK XKR 2006 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Jaguar XKR 2006 to 2015 model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer the upgraded Aero style blade too.
